name: Chichen Itza
heritage: World Heritage Site; Cultural property under special protection
text: Chichen Itza was a large pre-Columbian city built by the Maya people of the Terminal Classic period. The archeological site is located in Tinúm Municipality, Yucatán, Mexico, between the cities of Valladolid and Mérida. Chichen Itza was a major focal point in the Northern Maya Lowlands from the Late Classic (c.

depictions.name: Chichen Itza
depictions.text: Chichen Itza, located on the Yucatán Peninsula in Mexico, is a former Maya city, having been one of the largest of the pre-Columbian Maya civilization. Boasting a mix of architectural styles from across the empire, the site was known to include contributions from the Isu who were believed to have fought on the front lines of the human rebellion. As a result, the region was rich with ancient relics, leading the Templars to set up an excavation site there during the 18th century.
